copy.title: The Carter Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Jay-Z and Beyoncé’s family: who owns what, the one stock you can buy, the homes, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #020 · The Carter family · Data as of
copy.h1: Hip-hop’s first billionaire is married to another one. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them owns, which of their companies you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. The three kids appear by first name only.
copy.investLede: One company on this map trades on the stock market: Block, which owns most of Tidal and has Jay-Z on its board. The rest are private.
copy.moneyLede: Both of them have a published net worth. Forbes ties his to liquor brands, music, art and company stakes, and hers mostly to her music and tours.
copy.homesLede: What they paid, as reported. The Malibu house set a California record. No street addresses here.
copy.homesFlipLabel: Four homes, at purchase price (our math)
copy.recordLede: The deals behind the fortune: brand sales, an SEC filing and Forbes’s own math. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From Brooklyn’s Marcy Houses to a marriage of two billionaires.
copy.calcYearsK: Years to earn what Jay-Z has

summary.t: Rapper and businessman, born Shawn Carter and raised in Brooklyn’s Marcy Houses. Co-founder and chairman of Roc Nation. Forbes named him hip-hop’s first billionaire in 2019.

owns.t: Launched it in 2008 as a joint venture with Live Nation. It runs a record label, artist management and a sports agency. He is chairman.
Owned all of the champagne brand from 2014. Sold half to LVMH’s Moët Hennessy in February 2021; terms weren’t disclosed.
Launched the cognac with Bacardi in 2012. Bacardi bought a majority from him in February 2023, and he kept what it called a significant stake.
On Block’s board since May 2021 and a shareholder. Block paid him $320,530 in stock for board service in 2025.
Bought Aspiro, the company behind Tidal, for $56 million in 2015. Sold a majority to Square (now Block) in 2021 and still owns a stake.
Started the clothing brand in 1999 and sold it to Iconix for $204 million in 2007.

record.t: In 2019 Forbes valued his fortune at $1 billion: $310 million for Armand de Brignac, $220 million in cash and investments, $100 million each for D’Ussé and Tidal, $75 million each for Roc Nation and his music catalog, $70 million in art and $50 million in real estate.
Roc Nation joined Caesars Entertainment in a 2022 bid to build a casino hotel in Times Square. A community advisory committee voted it down in September 2025.

facts.t: Forbes says he has more than doubled his fortune since 2019, thanks to his liquor brands.
Reportedly bought into Uber for $2 million in 2013. Forbes valued that stake at about $70 million in 2019.
Paid a reported $4.5 million for Basquiat’s painting “Mecca” in 2013.
Ran Def Jam Recordings as president and CEO from 2004 to 2007.

kidsNote.t: Jay-Z and Beyoncé have three children. They appear here by first name only.

summary.t: Singer who first found fame in Destiny’s Child. She holds the record for most Grammy wins, with 35. Forbes counted her as a billionaire in December 2025.

owns.t: Founded it in 2010 to manage her own career. It produces her music, documentaries and concerts and pays most of the costs up front, so she keeps more of the profits.
Launched the hair-care line on Feb. 20, 2024. Her mother, Tina, is vice chair.
Whisky made with LVMH’s Moët Hennessy and named for her great-grandfather Davis Hogue. It went on sale in September 2024 at $89 a bottle.

record.t: Forbes says most of her wealth comes from her music: owning the rights to her catalog and touring. She is the fifth musician it counts as a billionaire.
Her Renaissance tour grossed nearly $600 million in 2023. Cowboy Carter was the world’s highest-grossing tour of 2025, per Forbes.

facts.t: Started the House of Deréon fashion line with her mother in 2004. Her Ivy Park clothing line ended in 2024.
She and Jay-Z paid a reported $200 million for a house in Malibu in May 2023, the most ever paid for a home in California.

summary.t: Raised Jay-Z and his three older siblings in Brooklyn after his father left. In 2003 she and Jay-Z started the Shawn Carter Foundation, which helps students facing hardship get through college.
Beyoncé’s mother. A businesswoman and designer who opened the Headliners salon in Houston in 1990 and started the House of Deréon fashion line with Beyoncé in 2004.

owns.t: Vice chair since the February 2024 launch. The brand grew out of her Headliners salon.

facts.t: Her memoir, Matriarch, came out in April 2025 and was Oprah’s Book Club pick that month.
Married Mathew Knowles in 1980; they divorced in 2011.

summary.t: Beyoncé’s father. Founded Music World Entertainment in 1992 and managed Destiny’s Child and the solo careers of Beyoncé and Solange. He is a visiting professor at Texas Southern University.
Beyoncé’s younger sister, a singer and songwriter. Her 2016 album A Seat at the Table reached No. 1, and she won a Grammy in 2017.

owns.t: Launched the record label in 2013, the same year she started the arts platform Saint Heron.

companies.name: Roc Nation

companies.name: Armand de Brignac

companies.t: Cognac launched with Bacardi in 2012. Bacardi took a majority in 2023. Private.

companies.name: Parkwood Entertainment

companies.t: Hair-care brand launched in February 2024 and sold in Ulta Beauty stores since 2025. Private.
